<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="11801">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="11857">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />11857 TKT - New open level is not within tolerance of prior close level</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="11857">

This exception is a user-defined exception in the Ticket Validation Template Editor and is generated on import and edit of tickets. This exception notifies users if the imported or manually entered value is not within tolerance of the prior close level. If the Tank Level Tolerance is defined in the Ticket Validation Template Editor, then this exception will be generated when the tolerance between new open level and prior close level exceeds the limit specified in the "Level Tolerance" field.

The tank level units specified in the [Tank Configuration \> Units & Options tab](../../../Tank%20Editor/Configuration/Tank%20Editor_Config%20-%20Units-Options%20Tab.md) are the units that are used for this validation.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexceptionExample MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exceptionExample MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="11857 Examples">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Examples</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="11857 Examples">

**Example 1:**

- Tank level unit: Inches
- Level tolerance: 6

The prior run ticket close level is set to 10’ 0” and the new run ticket open level is entered as 12’ 0”.

The difference between the prior close level and the open level is 2’ 0”. Since the tank level units are in inches, the difference is converted to 24 inches. This is above the level tolerance of 6, so the exception is generated.

**Example 2:**

- Tank level unit: Feet
- Level tolerance: 6

The prior run ticket close level is set to 10’ 0” and the new run ticket open level is entered as 12’ 0”

The difference between the prior close level and the open level is 2’ 0”. Since the tank’s level units are in feet, the difference is converted to 2 feet. This is below the Level Tolerance of 6, so the exception is not generated.

</div>

</div>

Only the Tank Run ticket type is associated with this exception.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="11858">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />11858 TKT - New gauge level is not within tolerance of prior gauge level</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="11858">

This exception is a user-defined exception in the Ticket Validation Template Editor and is generated on import and edit of tickets. This exception notifies users if the imported or manually entered value is not within tolerance of the prior gauge level. If the Tank Level Tolerance is defined in the Ticket Validation Template Editor, then this exception will be generated when the tolerance between new gauge level and prior gauge level exceeds the limit specified in the "Level Tolerance" field.

The tank level units specified in the Tank Configuration \> Units & Options tab are the units that are used for this validation.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexceptionExample MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exceptionExample MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="11858 Example">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Examples</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="11858 Example">

Example 1:

- Tank level unit: Inches
- Level tolerance: 6

The prior gauge ticket level is set to 10’ 0” and the new run ticket open level is entered as 12’ 0”.

The difference between the prior gauge level and the new gauge level is 2’ 0”. Since the tank level units are in inches, the difference is converted to 24 inches. This is above the level tolerance of 6, so the exception is generated.

Example 2:

- Tank level unit: Feet
- Level tolerance: 6

The gauge ticket level is set to 10’ 0” and the new gauge ticket level is entered as 12’ 0”.

The difference between the prior close level and the open level is 2’ 0”. Since the tank’s level units are in feet, the difference is converted to 2 feet. This is below the Level Tolerance of 6, so the exception is not generated.

</div>

</div>

Only the Gauge ticket type is associated with this exception.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="11859">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />11859 TKT – Level is below leg height</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="11859">

This gauge ticket exception is generated when the gauge level in a floating roof tank is lower than the floating roof leg height in the capacity table. When this happens, it indicates that the product level is in or below the critical zone and FRA should be 0. Floating roof leg height must be set in order to generate the exception.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="11860">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="11860">

This tank run ticket exception is generated when the open level in a floating roof tank is lower than the floating roof leg height in the capacity table. When this happens, it indicates that the open level is in or below the critical zone and FRA should be 0. Floating roof leg height must be set in order to generate the exception.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="11861">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />11861 TKT – Close level is below leg height</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="11861">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />11862 TKT - Ticket location is not an inventory (line pack ticket)</a>
